svg.title: Contoso Motors first Router deployment and platform caller admission
svg.desc: Create an Entra-protected Router in identity-probe mode. Configure APIM ingress. Invoke the exact diagnostic message through APIM as the certificate requester and read the SDK-verified platform caller ID. Create a business version with that caller, catalog and APIM settings while retaining the image and protocols. Wait for active state, select the version at 100 percent, and verify selection. Direct operator invocation identifies a different caller.

text.tspan: From identity probe to business routing
First deployment: learn the real platform caller before admitting business requests.
Wait until the version is active
Use the requester-to-APIM path. A direct operator call to Foundry identifies a different caller.
